1.1 Central construction

Use an antisymmetric step-function representation on an even grid of `n` points. Let `m = n // 2`. Define independent decision variables `p_i in [0,1]`, `i=0,...,m-1`, and set

```

```

For completeness, if an odd `n` were used, set the central sample to `0.5`; the default search will use even `n` only, so the center case is not normally used.

This representation guarantees the constraint

